meta.name: add-emacs
meta.description: Add Emacs as a channel. Opens an interactive chat buffer and org-mode integration so you can talk to NanoClaw from within Emacs (Doom, Spacemacs, or vanilla). Local HTTP bridge — no bot token or external service needed.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让 Emacs 直连 AI 助手,对话无需离开编辑器
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果离不开 Emacs,想在编辑器里随时向 AI 提问。
copy.tagline_en: Chat with your AI assistant right inside Emacs without switching tools
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you live in Emacs and want AI help without leaving your editor.

howto.what: 在 Emacs 中接入一个本地 HTTP 通道：可打开交互式聊天 buffer，或用 org-mode 发送当前子树或选中区域，回复以子标题形式落在 org 文件里。支持 Doom、Spacemacs 和 vanilla Emacs 27.1+，不需要 bot token 或外部服务。
howto.when: 当你在 Emacs 里按快捷键（如 C-c n c）打开聊天 buffer，或用 nanoclaw-org-send 发送 org 标题、选中区域时接管对话。

say.text: 解释一下我光标所在的这个函数
say.note: 在聊天 buffer 里发送，回复显示在 buffer 中

say.text: 帮我审查这段选中的代码
say.note: 发送选区，回复作为子标题插入当前 org 文件

say.text: 把这条 agenda 条目整理成行动项
say.note: 发送 org 条目，回复落在其子节点下

howto.what_en: Adds a local HTTP channel in Emacs: an interactive chat buffer, or send the current org subtree or region, with replies landing as child headings. Works with Doom, Spacemacs, or vanilla Emacs 27.1+ — no bot token or external service.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you open the chat buffer with your keybinding (e.g. C-c n c) or send an org heading or region with nanoclaw-org-send.

say_en.text: Explain the function my cursor is on
say_en.note: Sent in the chat buffer; reply appears there

say_en.text: Review the code I have selected
say_en.note: Sends the region; reply lands as a child heading

say_en.text: Turn this agenda entry into action items
say_en.note: Sends the org entry; reply lands as a child node
